doc.name: Forever In Our Hearts
doc.instructions: Public online memorials, death and funeral notices, and partner funeral homes from Forever In Our Hearts (foreverinourhearts.co for the US, UK, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand and other countries; foreverinourhearts.com.au for Australia). Read-only. Only pages the family or funeral home published and allowed in search engines are returned. Link people to the `url` of each result. Families create memorials at https://hub.foreverinourhearts.co.

tools.name: search_notices
tools.title: Search funeral notices
tools.description: Search published death and funeral notices by name, service location or funeral home. Newest first. Returns service times and places (local time with the time zone) and a link to each notice.

name.description: Name of the person (first name, last name or both)

location.description: Town, suburb, city or venue of the service

region.description: "au" for Australia (foreverinourhearts.com.au), "global" for every other country (foreverinourhearts.co). Omit to search both

tools.name: get_notice
tools.title: Get a funeral notice
tools.description: Full details of one published funeral notice: every service with its location, livestream link and information, the funeral home, and the memorial page if there is one.

id.description: Notice id from search_notices, or the notice's link

tools.name: search_memorials
tools.title: Search memorials
tools.description: Search published online memorials for people and pets by name. Newest first. Returns dates, the funeral home if there is one, and a link to each memorial.

name.description: Name of the person (first name, last name or both)

type.description: Memorials for people or for pets. Omit for both

region.description: "au" for Australia (foreverinourhearts.com.au), "global" for every other country (foreverinourhearts.co). Omit to search both

tools.name: get_memorial
tools.title: Get a memorial
tools.description: Details of one published memorial: dates, life story (obituary, shortened if long), service details, how many tributes it has, the funeral home and the link. Details the family keeps for QR code visitors are left out.

id.description: Memorial id from search_memorials, the memorial's link, or the last part of it (for example "example" in /memorials/example)

region.description: "au" for Australia (foreverinourhearts.com.au), "global" for every other country (foreverinourhearts.co). Omit to search both

tools.name: search_funeral_directors
tools.title: Search funeral directors
tools.description: Find funeral homes that are Forever In Our Hearts partners, by name, city, state or postcode, or by country. Returns name, logo, address, contact details and the funeral home's notices and memorials site.

query.description: Funeral home name, city, state or postcode

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example NZ, GB, US, CA, IE or AU

region.description: "au" for Australia (foreverinourhearts.com.au), "global" for every other country (foreverinourhearts.co). Omit to search both
